lines.text: Saul becomes king at thirty, picks three thousand men, and Jonathan attacks the Philistine outpost at Geba.
The people gather at Gilgal, and the Philistines camp at Michmash, so Israel's men hide in caves and cisterns.
Samuel does not come within three days, so Saul offers the burnt offering himself, and Samuel arrives just after.
Samuel tells Saul he acted foolishly, his kingdom will not endure, and the LORD has chosen a man after His own heart.
Saul counts about six hundred men at Geba, and on battle day only Saul and Abner have a sword or spear.
